The fandom ch 51 page carries an explicit reverse 'episode = Toguro Returns' field and the en-WP season 2 summaries split the content across eps 26/27 exactly as stored, so the batch-11 'rearranged 51-52 (first half)' annotation is confirmed unchanged. No repairs; en-WP +1 numbering trap (vol 8+) not triggered - all chapters here are below 64.
